description: Review published support for up to eight standalone mods before choosing what to install. Returns the stack you supplied alongside each mod's supported features, limitations, and questions to check against your application. Confirm the fit in your own project. Unknown or hidden IDs return an error.

environment.description: Describe the application stack you plan to use, such as "Node.js, Next.js, PostgreSQL, and Firebase Auth".

ids.description: One to eight standalone mod IDs returned by search_catalog.

items.description: Lowercase standalone mod ID from search_catalog, such as "funnel".

name: get_compatibility_guidance
title: Read compatibility guidance
